51528154.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to mitoNEET (unknown origin) by ITC method

original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Figure 2. Fluorescence assay with mitoNEET recombinant protein and ATP-fluorescein; and isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) data of the binding of ATP to mitoNEET (A) MitoNEET-ATP binding curve. Same concentration (20 μg/mL) of mitoNEET with ATP concentration ranging from (2.1 nM to 435 nM). Each point represents mean ± S.D. for N = 3 replicates. In (B), a mitoNEET-ATP and furosemide competition curve is shown. Same conditions as (A) for mitoNEET and ATP, before adding furosemide, with furosemide concentration ranging from (2 μM to 417 μM). Each point represents mean ± SD for n = 3 replicates. In (C), Comparing the fluorescence intensities of ATP-Fluorescein and mitoNEET-ATP-Fluorescein (mNT-ATP-Fluorescein). MitoNEET concentration is 20 μg/mL each in Tris-HCl at pH = 7.4. Each bar represents mean ± S.D. for n = 3 replicates. In (D), the top panel shows the heat signals that resulted in the integrated binding curve shown in the lower panel. Titrations were carried out at 25 °C using 5 mM Tris-HCl buffer (pH 7.4), ATP (222 μM) was titrated into mitoNEET (15 μM). One site binding model was used to fit the integrated binding curve.
